findings.title: RUN_URL accepts any github.com path, so an issue or pull request link passes as the run
findings.why_it_matters: The docstring requires a workflow run of this repository. https://github.com/acme/app/issues/123 matches and the summary renders it as 'see the run', which leads to an issue in any repository.
findings.suggested_fix: Match the repository and the actions/runs/<id> path exactly, with an optional /attempts/<n>.
